items.title: What Does Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Risk From The Revived $6.7 Billion Lawsuit?
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) is facing a revived US$6.7b lawsuit after a federal appeals court reinstated claims tied to its Celgene acquisition. Plaintiffs allege the company deliberately delayed FDA approval of certain drugs to avoid paying contingent value rights owed to former Celgene shareholders.
